description:

Steve is 63, Karen is 61, and they have $900,000 in traditional IRAs. At 75 the IRS will force out about $32,038. They need about $30,900 from that account that year anyway. Their real problem is somewhere else: the Social Security tax torpedo (22% on income in the 12% bracket), the year one of them dies and the survivor files single, and the kids' 10-year clock on whatever's left.
